breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradiction between the periodic domain and the specified Dirichlet boundary condition. The incomplete prompt listed both periodic conditions and a Dirichlet condition (u=0). The agent correctly removed the incompatible Dirichlet condition, aligning with the ground truth which only specifies periodic boundary conditions.
